# @skbkontur/react-ui
> A comprehensive React component library providing UI components, validation tools, and design utilities for building user interfaces.

## Docs

- [Full Documentation](https://tech.skbkontur.ru/kontur-ui/llms-full.txt): Complete documentation with all components, props, and examples
